report:
Reviewed the complete query_projection claim, both ordinary implementation associations (sage-host trace.rs and harness observe.rs), and both ordinary associated tests. No TODO/N/A entries are present.

Stable operations and identities: query_operation removes parenthesized debug arguments; semantic phase/span nodes carry stable operation values as Semantic keys. Unknown Salsa and external metadata keys remain Unmapped. snapshot_trace recursively replaces only unmapped ingredients with operation names, deliberately retaining the unmapped tag rather than claiming argument identities. collect uses this shared Inspector projection and serializes its typed nodes as pretty JSON, not raw debug golden strings. Captured Inspector deterministic_trace claim and protocol definitions confirm the common representation and policy. The cold-project test compares full serialized traces from independently prepared projects, requires real executed/body work, and rejects /tmp/ and Id( leakage.

Parentage, multiplicity, and dispositions: build_dynamic_trace uses a stack for nested spans/queries and attaches children to the current parent. QueryLeaf observations are copied, query exits and leaves map Executed/Validated/Reused/Cancelled directly, while semantic spans are Observed. No projection filter discards unknown operations or duplicate observations. The structural test asserts one parent with exactly two children, finds the unknown zeta operation, asserts its count of three, and checks serialized reused disposition and unmapped zeta identity. Together with the production test's executed assertion this supplies visible behavioral assertions for the available execution/reuse distinction.

Ordering: normalizing sequential nodes returns without sorting. Only ChildOrder::Unordered nodes sort; snapshot normalization recursively removes unstable ingredients before its final unordered sort. The structural test deliberately supplies zeta before alpha and asserts that exact sequence for Sequential, and alpha before zeta for Unordered. This catches accidental blanket sorting as well as absent canonical sorting. Root order and parentage remain preserved. Allocation-dependent query arguments are explicitly injected in this test and asserted absent from serialized output.

Dependencies: captured CompileTest setup/prepare to establish genuinely independent temporary projects and the call into observe::collect; captured Inspector protocol types to inspect serde names, unmapped tagging, observation defaults, and nested children. Projection behavior itself is fully contained in the two associated implementation files; those auxiliary definitions/setup do not add another projection implementation. No uncaptured helper behavior is relied on for the projection judgment.

Validation: cargo test -p sage-test-harness --test review_semantics query_projection_preserves_structure_and_sorts_only_unordered_siblings passed (1 test). cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib cold_queries_are_stable_across_isolated_projects passed (1 test).. These focused executions supplement the source inspection; no full workspace test or build was run by this reviewer. No code changes or requested edits.
